description: A React component that provides a tutorial for the Tic Tac Toe game, guiding users through gameplay and features.

methods.name: GameTutorial()
methods.description: Main functional component responsible for rendering the tutorial interface for the Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: completeTutorial
methods.description: Marks the tutorial as seen and closes the tutorial overlay.

methods.name: renderTutorialBoard
methods.description: Renders the tutorial board based on the provided image identifier.

methods.name: renderEmptyBoard
methods.description: Renders an empty Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: renderGridBoard
methods.description: Renders a numbered Tic Tac Toe board.

methods.name: renderMovesBoard
methods.description: Renders a Tic Tac Toe board with predefined moves.

methods.name: renderWinningBoard
methods.description: Renders a Tic Tac Toe board showing a winning combination.

methods.name: renderGameModes
methods.description: Renders the available game modes for Tic Tac Toe.
